segments.normalizedSource: ```objc - (BOOL)getObjectValue:(id *)obj forString:(NSString *)string errorDescription:(NSString **)error { float floatResult; NSScanner *scanner; BOOL returnValue = NO; scanner = [NSScanner scannerWithString: string]; [scanner scanString: @"$" intoString: NULL]; // ignore return value if ([scanner scanFloat:&floatResult] && ([scanner isAtEnd])) { returnValue = YES; if (obj) { *obj = [NSNumber numberWithFloat:floatResult]; } } else { if (error) { *error = NSLocalizedString(@"Couldn’t convert to float", @"Error converting"); } } return returnValue; } ```
